maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes mainly from building and selling new homes (Ryan Homes, NVHomes, Heartland Homes); mortgage banking is the smaller segment.

publicly_funded.reason: Homebuyers are private consumers, financed by mortgages; NVR Mortgage serves its own homebuyers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically by building and selling homes in its own communities; no steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers buy a one-time new home and can choose other homebuilders; no ongoing switching cost for buyers.
